execution_claim: Approved case status is retained verbatim as historical catalogue metadata, not a current dashboard. WP1–WP4 test evidence is recorded separately in the program; no engine tests ran for this reconciliation.

approved_cases.scenario: Migrate legacy AC with unknown contributions
approved_cases.required_result: Preserve labelled legacy baseline/override; no invented provenance or double application

approved_cases.scenario: Old client writes calculated field after cutover
approved_cases.required_result: Translate to allowed command or reject; no second authoritative write

approved_cases.scenario: Two representations and two independent campaign occurrences
approved_cases.required_result: Same occurrence shares resources; independent campaigns do not

approved_cases.scenario: Two commands spend last shared charge
approved_cases.required_result: One succeeds; current never negative

approved_cases.scenario: Crash before checkpoint commit, then retry
approved_cases.required_result: No partial change or exposed uncommitted roll; one eventual outcome

approved_cases.scenario: Crash after commit before response; retry on another worker
approved_cases.required_result: Same receipt, roll and debit; no extra effect

approved_cases.scenario: Reuse idempotency key with altered target/amount
approved_cases.required_result: IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE; no second execution

approved_cases.scenario: Duplicate outbox delivery and lost socket delta
approved_cases.required_result: Apply event once; recover permitted consistent snapshot

approved_cases.scenario: Revoke responder access while prompt is open
approved_cases.required_result: Reject old answer; no secret result; suspend/reassign as specified

approved_cases.scenario: Operator changes relevant mechanical context
approved_cases.required_result: Invalidate prompt; stale token cannot authorize effects

approved_cases.scenario: Optional versus mandatory decision times out
approved_cases.required_result: Declared optional decline or mandatory suspension; no invented answer

approved_cases.scenario: Cancel after committed roll and retry
approved_cases.required_result: Preserve roll; no precommit cancellation or free reroll

approved_cases.scenario: Reaction chain exceeds depth or cycles
approved_cases.required_result: Bounded checkpoint failure; retain earlier commits and suspend

approved_cases.scenario: Permute base 10, ADD 2, MULTIPLY 2 serialization
approved_cases.required_result: Result 24 and equivalent provenance under core-safe-1

approved_cases.scenario: Different SET values at equal highest priority
approved_cases.required_result: EFFECT_CONFLICT; arrival order cannot select winner

approved_cases.scenario: Compare incremental with full evaluation across generated fixtures
approved_cases.required_result: Equal values, unresolved markers and source contributions

approved_cases.scenario: Reorder initiative; duplicate turn/recovery events
approved_cases.required_result: Stable occurrence IDs; no repeated cadence/recovery

approved_cases.scenario: Source-turn versus each-turn cadence
approved_cases.required_result: Distinct declared buckets behave as specified

approved_cases.scenario: Restore pinned campaign after package/evaluator release
approved_cases.required_result: Replay exact lock and recorded outcomes or explicit unavailable state

approved_cases.scenario: Max charges decreases from 3 to 1; current is 2
approved_cases.required_result: Block until explicit conversion; record approved exact delta

approved_cases.scenario: Roll back package update after new gameplay
approved_cases.required_result: Evaluate current state; no stale snapshot overwrite

approved_cases.scenario: Player explains/exports value influenced by hidden curse
approved_cases.required_result: Only approved declassified result; private metadata absent

approved_cases.scenario: GM warms cache; player/other campaign requests same IDs
approved_cases.required_result: No audience/policy/scope cache crossover

approved_cases.scenario: View As requests owner-private field and mutation
approved_cases.required_result: No extra private rights; refuse mutation

approved_cases.scenario: Revoke membership mid-subscription; retry old receipt
approved_cases.required_result: Use current policy; no stale privileged payload

approved_cases.scenario: Huge valid graph, trigger loop, archive bomb or external asset
approved_cases.required_result: Enforce declared budgets/isolation; no partial current checkpoint

approved_cases.scenario: Same NPC installed in two campaigns; one changes allegiance
approved_cases.required_result: Independent state; definition/other campaign unchanged

approved_cases.scenario: Two sources grant proficiency; revoke one
approved_cases.required_result: Surviving source preserves proficiency

approved_cases.scenario: Remove level after granted item was transferred/consumed
approved_cases.required_result: Conflict or accepted compensation; no blind deletion/recreation

approved_cases.scenario: Undo after later action changes affected resource
approved_cases.required_result: UNDO_CONFLICT or declared compensation; preserve later work

approved_cases.scenario: Harmless flames; change an earlier interview answer
approved_cases.required_result: No damage invented; invalidate dependent answers/effects visibly

approved_cases.scenario: Guided -> Advanced -> Guided, locale/schema change
approved_cases.required_result: Retain valid decisions; ask new ambiguities instead of defaulting

approved_cases.scenario: Contradictory/cyclic interview constraints
approved_cases.required_result: Finite GUIDE_DEAD_END and recovery; no infinite loop

approved_cases.scenario: Progress-clock/success-pool ruleset fixture
approved_cases.required_result: Use declared contracts without core rest/turn hardcoding

approved_cases.scenario: Publish lore-only content; falsely claim automation with human-only predicate
approved_cases.required_result: Allow valid lore publication; reject false automation claim

approved_cases.scenario: Import forged owner, existing instance ID and grants
approved_cases.required_result: Inert preview and authorized remap; no authority takeover

approved_cases.scenario: Required export dependency is not redistributable
approved_cases.required_result: Explicit external-reference report or failure; no false self-contained export

approved_cases.scenario: Adapter loses resource cost or visibility
approved_cases.required_result: Disclose loss and accept or block; no preserved automation claim

approved_cases.scenario: Transclusion cycle, private endpoint, teleport through region
approved_cases.required_result: Bounded authorized rendering; specified endpoint transitions only

approved_cases.scenario: Concurrent edges exceed relationship cardinality
approved_cases.required_result: One consistent accepted state; reject conflicting edit

approved_cases.scenario: Reference workload with simulations/exports
approved_cases.required_result: Report p95/p99/errors; no live starvation; correct limits

approved_cases.scenario: Restore pending prompt, dedupe records and outbox
approved_cases.required_result: Consistent fenced authority; no repeated roll/spend or unauthorized delivery

approved_cases.scenario: Rounding plus unknown/divide-by-zero input
approved_cases.required_result: Explicit rounding; fail invalid checkpoint without NaN/partial writes

approved_cases.scenario: Regenerate publication under newer renderer/theme
approved_cases.required_result: New artifact ID; old promised artifact retained/verifiable

approved_cases.scenario: Novices author item, conditional effect, choice and lore
approved_cases.required_result: Report completion/errors/abandonment; no hidden creative defaults

approved_cases.scenario: Reference deleted entity or withdrawn package
approved_cases.required_result: Tombstone/retained lock or explicit unavailable result; never substitute by name

approved_cases.scenario: Responder enumerates candidate hidden values against a delivered context token and public receipt
approved_cases.required_result: No match is possible; no unkeyed digest over unreadable content and no omitted-event count is delivered

approved_cases.scenario: Cut over one character of a two-character campaign; legacy edit during an engine action
approved_cases.required_result: Cutover is scope-wide and a per-character cutover is rejected; no engine action reads a legacy-authoritative value

approved_cases.scenario: Actor holds two occurrences of one item revision and invokes the second
approved_cases.required_result: Only the named source occurrence's resources change; an invocation without a source occurrence is schema-invalid

approved_cases.scenario: Operator resolves an action manually; a player attempts a manual adjustment of another player's resource
approved_cases.required_result: Outcome records adjudicator and reason and is labelled manual in every projection; the player's attempt returns OPERATION_FORBIDDEN and changes nothing

approved_cases.scenario: Operator reorders initiative while a reaction slot is being offered
approved_cases.required_result: Slot restarts under the new order; recorded decliners are not offered again; no candidate is offered twice in one slot

approved_cases.scenario: Invoker withdraws one PROPOSED action; another passes its precommit deadline
approved_cases.required_result: Both become CANCELLED without cost or checkpoint; the open-proposal admission count is released

approved_cases.scenario: Oversized request body; definition over a declared structural bound; budget exceeded in a later checkpoint
approved_cases.required_result: 413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE; 422 BUDGET_EXCEEDED with nothing written; 422 BUDGET_EXCEEDED with SUSPENDED status and earlier checkpoints intact

approved_cases.scenario: Server clock steps forward, or the service is down, past an open decision's deadline; later the clock steps back
approved_cases.required_result: The decision is not expired or answered and its action becomes SUSPENDED for operator review; the backward step reopens no expired decision

approved_cases.scenario: Token moves while an action is pending, on a map without declared spatial mechanics
approved_cases.required_result: The move commits as representation state, triggers no mechanics and is not refused as SCOPE_BUSY

approved_cases.scenario: Token moves while an action is pending, on a map whose geometry profile declares spatial mechanics
approved_cases.required_result: The move is refused with SCOPE_BUSY and changes nothing

proposed_cases.scenario: One activity has ammunition and charge costs; retry through another transport; also two legitimate costs against one pool
proposed_cases.required_result: Each declared logical cost applies once; distinct cost IDs remain distinct; aggregate availability is checked and the original receipt is recovered

proposed_cases.scenario: Fault after a legacy adapter prepares a resource change but before the full receipt/outbox unit commits
proposed_cases.required_result: No partial checkpoint persists; helpers cannot commit independently; postcommit retry recovers the full prior outcome

proposed_cases.scenario: One occurrence has a live dungeon view and conflicting reference views on other scenes; compare independent copies
proposed_cases.required_result: Only the canonical presence establishes geometry/events/vision; references do not toggle conditions; independent occurrences retain independent state

proposed_cases.scenario: Transform, equip, and rebuild repeatedly; permute unordered contributors and compare full/incremental results
proposed_cases.required_result: No derived value is reapplied as a base; values, unknowns, conflicts and canonical provenance match without persistent projection side effects

proposed_cases.scenario: Edit a nested draft answer, commit and reload in a new session; repeat with precommit failure
proposed_cases.required_result: Answer and descendant invalidation persist together on success; neither persists on failure

proposed_cases.scenario: Similar content names under distinct rules editions/evaluators; restore with an exact required artifact missing
proposed_cases.required_result: Use the selected exact closure or report unavailable; no edition/name/latest fallback; migration reconciliation remains explicit

proposed_cases.scenario: Request a private contribution through every output surface, warm another audience cache, then revoke access
proposed_cases.required_result: Only declared declassification is exposed; old receipts/delayed jobs use current policy; no private names, IDs, links, or omitted counts escape

proposed_cases.scenario: Compound function and child actions approach root fuel limits; force aborts, worker restart, and five automatic attempts
proposed_cases.required_result: Internal work and committed root charges persist correctly; operational retries do not refill episodes or change logical fuel; exhaustion has no partial game effect

proposed_cases.scenario: Canonicalize Unicode-key and numeric-boundary vectors across runtimes; parse duplicate-key source bytes
proposed_cases.required_result: Identical valid canonical bytes/hashes; reject duplicate keys before collapse and invalid mechanical values; zero/false/missing/unknown stay distinct

proposed_cases.scenario: Restart a pending spatial decision; expire worker lease; accept one valid answer then deliver late/stale/revoked responses
proposed_cases.required_result: Same action and committed rolls; only one eligible current-context answer; stale worker fence and old presence contexts cannot commit

proposed_cases.scenario: Concurrent placement, move or transfer commands use the same scope and presence version
proposed_cases.required_result: At most one conflicting new transition commits; no second presence or lost update; duplicates return their receipt

proposed_cases.scenario: Move, hide, delete or select a reference/live display; open another browser scene
proposed_cases.required_result: No unintended relocation, invisibility, aura, vision or cadence change; deleting a view preserves its occurrence and presence

proposed_cases.scenario: Transfer between scenes across regions with a pre-departure decision, post-arrival reaction, and lost response
proposed_cases.required_result: Old presence remains until relocation commit; departure/arrival reconcile once; later suspension preserves destination and prior state; active unrelated transfer is busy

proposed_cases.scenario: Unplace and re-place a poisoned occurrence with spent resource and cadence; attempt spatial action while unplaced
proposed_cases.required_result: Explicit authority and exit/entry rules; poison/spend/cadence persist; required geometry is unresolved and returns spatial guidance or authorized manual resolution

proposed_cases.scenario: Two live views of one occurrence and two independent occurrences of one definition overlap the same region
proposed_cases.required_result: Deduplicate views by InstanceRef; independent targets retain distinct per-target cadence; scene transfer never resets logical buckets

proposed_cases.scenario: Introduce a framework/ORM/network import or ambient randomness/commit into the domain boundary
proposed_cases.required_result: Automated architecture/purity checks reject the violation; pure domain fixtures run without application or database startup

proposed_cases.scenario: Equivalent authorized semantic commands arrive via REST, sockets and legacy adapter with transport differences
proposed_cases.required_result: Same semantic handler, digest identity, costs and current-policy outcome; transport-specific payload cannot bypass the command boundary

proposed_cases.scenario: Evaluate the same snapshot with cold cache, warm cache and incremental optimization at logical fuel boundaries
proposed_cases.required_result: Same reference charge and acceptance/result/provenance; actual CPU may differ; operational interruption is not misreported as deterministic budget exhaustion

requirements.contract: Recorded, labelled manual adjudication without extra privileges; §2
Occurrence-owned presence with E4-compatible representation edits; §28.1
Stable contribution identities/order and pure projection; §§27, 28.3
Logical fuel separate from bounded operational recovery; §28.4
Explicit dependency, type and side-effect evidence; §27
Additional lock, policy, recovery and adapter evidence; §§27–28
